for rec in records:
# ── Validation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── if rec.x_precise_position: if not (0 <= (rec.x_offset_right or 0) <= 250): raise UserError('Right offset (PX) must be between 0 and 250.') if not (0 <= (rec.x_offset_bottom or 0) <= 250): raise UserError('Bottom offset (PX) must be between 0 and 250.') if rec.x_custom_icon_size: if not (20 <= (rec.x_custom_icon_size_px or 50) <= 150): raise UserError('Custom icon size must be between 20 and 150 pixels.')
# ── Save all settings to ICP ────────────────────────────────────────── ICP = env['ir.config_parameter'].sudo() ICP.set_param('odoo-allinoneaccessibilitypro.color_code', (rec.x_color_code or '420083').lstrip('#')) ICP.set_param('odoo-allinoneaccessibilitypro.style', rec.x_style or 'bottom_right') ICP.set_param('odoo-allinoneaccessibilitypro.precise_position', str(bool(rec.x_precise_position))) ICP.set_param('odoo-allinoneaccessibilitypro.icon_type', rec.x_icon_type or 'aioa-icon-type-1') ICP.set_param('odoo-allinoneaccessibilitypro.size', rec.x_size or 'regular') ICP.set_param('odoo-allinoneaccessibilitypro.icon_size_desktop', rec.x_icon_size_desktop or 'aioa-default-icon') ICP.set_param('odoo-allinoneaccessibilitypro.custom_icon_size', str(bool(rec.x_custom_icon_size))) ICP.set_param('odoo-allinoneaccessibilitypro.custom_icon_size_px', str(rec.x_custom_icon_size_px or 50)) ICP.set_param('odoo-allinoneaccessibilitypro.offset_right', str(rec.x_offset_right or 20)) ICP.set_param('odoo-allinoneaccessibilitypro.offset_right_dir', rec.x_offset_right_dir or 'to_the_left') ICP.set_param('odoo-allinoneaccessibilitypro.offset_bottom', str(rec.x_offset_bottom or 20)) ICP.set_param('odoo-allinoneaccessibilitypro.offset_bottom_dir', rec.x_offset_bottom_dir or 'to_the_bottom')
# ── Build widget payload dict (no json.dumps — stored as key=value pairs) ─ base_url = ICP.get_param('web.base.url', '') domain = base_url if '://' in base_url: parts = base_url.split('://') host = parts[1].split('/')[0].split(':')[0] domain = parts[0] + '://' + host
color = (rec.x_color_code or '420083').lstrip('#') precise = bool(rec.x_precise_position) custom_sz = bool(rec.x_custom_icon_size) size = rec.x_size or 'regular'
wp = { 'u': domain, 'widget_color_code': '#' + color, 'widget_icon_type': rec.x_icon_type or 'aioa-icon-type-1', 'widget_position': '' if precise else (rec.x_style or 'bottom_right'), 'widget_size': 1 if size == 'oversize' else 0, 'is_widget_custom_position': 1 if precise else 0, 'is_widget_custom_size': 1 if custom_sz else 0, } if custom_sz: wp['widget_icon_size'] = '' wp['widget_icon_size_custom'] = rec.x_custom_icon_size_px or 50 else: wp['widget_icon_size'] = rec.x_icon_size_desktop or 'aioa-default-icon' wp['widget_icon_size_custom'] = 0 if precise: # Set position parameters based on direction # Horizontal position if rec.x_offset_right_dir == 'to_the_right': wp['widget_position_left'] = None wp['widget_position_right'] = rec.x_offset_right or 20 else: # to_the_left (default) wp['widget_position_left'] = rec.x_offset_right or 20 wp['widget_position_right'] = None
# Vertical position if rec.x_offset_bottom_dir == 'to_the_top': wp['widget_position_bottom'] = None wp['widget_position_top'] = rec.x_offset_bottom or 20 else: # to_the_bottom (default) wp['widget_position_bottom'] = rec.x_offset_bottom or 20 wp['widget_position_top'] = None
# Store as JSON string for JS to consume # json is available in Odoo safe_eval context (v16+) ICP.set_param('odoo-allinoneaccessibilitypro.pending_widget_payload', json.dumps(wp))
